scope: Coverage and limits from the reviewer final message. This is an attestation, not an independently exported image-view tool trace. Original scores remain in the byte-preserved locked review.
message: Saved review.json in the assigned reviewer-2 directory. Coverage includes all 12 outputs and six matched pairs, reviewed in the supplied order, with 279 unique images actually inspected: 156 individual stable captures, 36 supplemental captures, 60 ordered temporal samples, 24 overview sheets, and all three benchmark images. All T1 stable width/theme combinations were inspected individually. T2 originals covered every working view at 1440 initial theme, 900 alternate theme, and 390 in both themes; remaining combinations were inspected through overview sheets. T3 compact, expanded, second-source, error, and note captures were inspected individually at all supplied widths; its 900-pixel notebook view was inspected through the overview. Continuous natural motion remains unassessed. Screenshots do not establish functional correctness, persistence, keyboard/accessibility behavior, or physical-device behavior. Scores and preferences remain in the saved file for locking.
